script.speaker: student
script.text: I lost my umbrella yesterday. Is it here?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: We have two umbrellas. One is black, one is blue.

script.speaker: student
script.text: Mine is blue. It is very small.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Then this one is yours. Please write your name here.

question.stem: Which umbrella belongs to the student?
question.explain_tr: Öğrenci 'Mine is blue' diyor. Siyah şemsiye de var ama ona ait değil.
